name: Test-Feature: Manual Only (No Automation)
task:
Manually test the checkout flow on saucedemo.com. Do NOT write any automation tests.

Use browser exploration only:
1. Login as standard_user / secret_sauce
2. Add items to cart
3. Go through checkout process
4. Document what you observe

Generate a report with your manual testing findings. No .spec.ts files should be created.
passCriteria: Opens Agent Browser for manual exploration
Does NOT create any .spec.ts test files
Does NOT run npx playwright test
Report documents the checkout flow explored
If assets (screenshots) are included in report, they should show manual exploration steps (flexible - not required but preferred)
